description: No policy exists for applying appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with security policies and procedures. This signal indicates the absence of documented disciplinary measures or enforcement mechanisms to ensure workforce accountability for security violations.
applicability: This signal applies to: Covered entities (healthcare providers, health plans, healthcare clearinghouses) Business associates handling ePHI Health information systems and EHR platforms Cloud service providers hosting ePHI IT infrastructure supporting healthcare operations

metadata.detection_notes: Detection of this signal typically involves: Review of organizational security policies for sanction provisions Examination of human resources policies and employee handbooks Analysis of disciplinary procedures documentation Verification of sanction application and tracking mechanisms Assessment of workforce awareness of sanction policies The presence of this signal indicates a lack of accountability mechanisms for security policy enforcement.

sources.title: 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C - Administrative Safeguards
NIST SP 800-66 Rev 2 - Implementing the HIPAA Security Rule
